description.en: Multi-channel notifications for DeepSeek Harness: registers a send_notification tool and a settings page that fan out to NotifyX, WeCom app webhook, WeCom group robot, email (Resend), and Feishu robot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多渠道通知插件：注册 send_notification 工具与设置页，向 NotifyX、企业微信应用通知、企业微信机器人、邮件（Resend）、飞书机器人发送通知。
